intent: Implement Feature 002 SQLite ownership, migration and transaction repository with strict codecs, metadata history and disk recovery. Preserve cancellation, unknown outcomes and no-replay semantics.

findings.suggested_fix: Map the safe schema/context cause, then preserve errMigrationOutcome as the outer TransactionError before returning the category.
findings.title: Preserve unknown migration outcomes before schema categories
findings.why_it_matters: A failed rollback during an already-corrupt or incompatible schema inspection is reported only as a schema error. The caller loses the required unknown-outcome signal and cannot follow the documented readback recovery contract.
evidence: Isolated TestOpenCause_RetainsMigrationUnknownOutcome fails: unknown cleanup outcome hidden by storage: corrupt data.

findings.suggested_fix: Preserve context.Canceled and context.DeadlineExceeded from ledger queries/scans and canonical replay before classifying schema failures.
findings.title: Preserve cancellation during schema inspection
findings.why_it_matters: Canceling Open during ledger inspection or canonical schema replay incorrectly reports corruption or incompatibility. That violates R16 and can direct a caller to database recovery instead of honoring cancellation.
evidence: internal/storage/migrations.go:106 -- return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid canonical schema", errIncompatibleSchema)
Isolated TestInspection_PreservesCancellationCause fails for ledger and canonical replay with corrupt/incompatible public categories.
